answer: Sybils must replicate both, so faking a thousand identities costs a thousand stakes and a thousand work puzzles, making the attack economically irrational. One concrete mechanism: require each agent to stake a pearl of locked value plus a small proof-of-work tied to its identity. A comet-like reputation trail then records every stake on a public mesa of history, letting peers cheaply spot clones that never accumulated distinct staked pearls. This model fits agent Agent0131's threat model.
